newsitem.title: USA: Sparks pegs US soybean stocks 1.087 bln bu - trade.
newsitem.headline: Sparks pegs US soybean stocks 1.087 bln bu - trade.

text.p: Memphis-based analytical firm Sparks Companies has estimated U.S. stocks of soybeans as of March 1, at 1.087 billion bushels, trade sources said.
The total was below the average estimate in a Reuter survey of analysts issued earlier Wednesday of 1.093 billion and the U.S. Department of Agriculture's estimate for March 1, 1996 of 1.190 billion.
Sparks put corn stocks, as of March 1, at 4.570 billion, marginally above the average of analysts' estimates at 4.565 billion and up from USDA's year-earlier 3.800 billion.
A spokesman for Sparks Companies declined comment.
Wheat stocks were estimated at 843 million by Sparks up from an average analysts' estimate of 827 million bushels and the USDA's year-earlier total of 823 million, sources said.
The U.S. Department of Agriculture is due to issue stocks data, as of March 1, on Monday.
